title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting
abstract: arXiv:2611.23896v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that combines learned nonlinear features with covariance-guided memory updates. It stores associations through recursive ridge regression, using correlations among past keys to determine how new observations modify memory. A content-dependent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition controls retention and restores uncertainty for future writes. This construction admits an exact temporal-kernel interpretation and maintains an inference state whose size is independent of context length. Associative block maps and explicit adjoints support parallel training while preserving the recursive update. In controlled language-modeling experiments, KRA improves prediction quality over attention and recurrent baselines, strengthens natural associative recall over the evaluated recurrent models, and achieves practical distributed training throughput. translated_title: 核岭注意力：具有选择性遗忘的非线性记忆
translated_abstract: 核岭注意力（Kernel Ridge Attention, KRA）是一种循环序列混合器，它将学习到的非线性特征与由协方差引导的记忆更新相结合。它通过递归岭回归来存储关联，利用过去键之间的相关性来决定新观测如何修改记忆。一个依赖于内容的 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 转移控制信息的保留程度，并为未来的写入恢复不确定性。这一构造具有精确的时间核函数解释，并维持一个大小与上下文长度无关的推理状态。关联块映射和显式伴随算子支持并行训练，同时保留递归更新。在受控的语言建模实验中，KRA 相比注意力和循环基线提升了预测质量，在所评估的循环模型中增强了自然关联回忆能力，并实现了实用的分布式训练吞吐量。这些性质为其提供了一个有原则的基础。
tldr: 提出核岭注意力（KRA），一种通过递归岭回归实现非线性记忆更新、结合内容依赖的选择性遗忘机制、推理状态大小与上下文长度无关且在语言建模中优于注意力与循环基线的循环序列混合器。
en_tdlr: Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that stores nonlinear associations via recursive ridge regression with content-dependent selective forgetting, maintaining a context-length-independent inference state while outperforming attention and recurrent baselines in language modeling.
